environment.gpu: NVIDIA-SMI has failed because it couldn't communicate with the NVIDIA driver. Make sure that the latest NVIDIA driver is installed and running.

config.comparison: Paired estimators and threshold methods on identical new datasets and task-resampling indices. Calibration tasks drawn first then failure tasks; seed+10000000 bootstrap. Cache only exactly equal threshold fits within a bootstrap.
config.method: Grimshaw profile stationary solutions with gamma>-1, compared with uniform boundary gamma=-1 sigma=max(excesses). Boundary or numerical failure is unusable, never clipped into an accepted shape.

reference.sections: 2.1-2.2 and published nylon example in section 4
reference.sign_convention: project gamma equals minus paper k

config.reporting: Report all scenarios/candidates, availability, coverage conditional and counting unavailable as failure, common-pair coverage and gains/losses, mean point bias, CI width, family null false rejection. No automatic promotion; overlap with nominal is inconclusive, upper binomial bound below nominal detects undercoverage.
config.scope: P3 GPD numerical method validation at q=.01 only. Not a whole P1/P2/P3 gate, not q=.001 validation. Main production estimator and all main labels remain untouched.
